response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with deep expertise in web/backend development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) but shows no substantive C++ experience beyond a brief 6-month stint in 2014-2015 writing C/C++ components for an IDE, no Windows platform development, no SQL Server/Oracle depth, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure. The core mandatory requirements of the role are essentially unmet.
strengths: Highly experienced senior/staff-level engineer with 15+ years across many domains and languages
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing) valuable in any engineering context
Excellent communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: Only ~6 months of C++ experience (2014-2015), far short of the 5-10 years required
No evidence of Windows platform development; recent work is Linux/cloud/web focused
No fixed income, capital markets, investment banking, or Summit platform experience

key_factors.factor: No capital markets/fixed income domain exposure
